findings.title: A view-only grant allows creating groups
findings.body: This method treats the `VIEW` scope on the all-groups resource as `canManage()`. `GroupsResource.addTopLevelGroup` relies on `requireManage()`, so an administrator granted only view access to all groups can create top-level groups. Require the `MANAGE` scope for this check.

findings.title: Evaluate impersonation grants as the requester, not the target user
findings.body: When a requester is supplied, this context uses the impersonated target user as the authorization identity. `canClientImpersonate` delegates to this overload, so its permission check evaluates policies against the target rather than the requesting client/current administrator. This can deny valid requester grants or allow impersonation based on the target user's identity instead of the caller's authorization.

findings.title: Return group IDs, not authorization resource IDs
findings.body: This adds an authorization resource's database ID to the set used as `UserModel.GROUPS` search filters, but that set must contain realm group IDs. In particular, an all-groups `VIEW_MEMBERS` grant causes user searches to filter by the synthetic Groups resource ID, which matches no group and omits authorized members. Also, per-group resources created by `AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource` are not assigned the `Groups` type, so this `findByType` scan does not enumerate those grants.
